scope: Fresh crop selection and full fitting on all 22 development photographs using frozen automatic MobileSAM predictions. Existing single-point + contrast fallback policy first. Only if it has no supported crop, try the original locator with the automatic two-paper prompt silhouette.
rationale: Earlier two-paper prompting recovered hand-held and foliage checkers but lost aircraft and ribbon checker. Test conditional scheduling rather than global replacement or selection by resulting template score.
invariants: No original source pixels, learned fields, paper palettes, masks or known corner references are changed.
Supported primary crops must match exactly, including resulting classified masks and observation coverage.
Only crop support determines whether to invoke the third attempt; no labels, template scores or manual per-image method assignments.
Use the original locator for the two-paper branch, with no new threshold or objective change.
All 22 photos remain in the denominator; no learned model is integrated or retrained.
Ten-second fitting allowance and unchanged image, feature, geometry, nominal paper and editable checks.
Review new crops and outputs visually. Compare the fixed independent source-paper and approximate corner references where available.
Cached model outputs exclude inference time; report crop attempts and time separately from fitting, never as browser latency.
